criteria.title: Handle partial reads and writes, EOF, and zero progress. - capstone composition
criteria.task: Run the exact six-call output script in boundaries.json against a 13-byte retained frame. Record offered pointer offset/length, callback result, accepted bytes and ownership after each call. Implement no-progress scheduling, interruption handling and terminal error reporting. Inject remaining+1 as a separate invalid adapter return and reject it before advancing or reading beyond the frame. Add a typed adapter using the learner-owned errors.result contract (PR-T65-04/LAB-ER-08); retain cursor progress separately from the tagged final outcome. Compare its size, checks and failure path with the baseline under identical semantics.
criteria.purpose: Retrying a full message after a partial write is harmless.

criteria.title: Handle registration changes, descriptor reuse, and stale events. - capstone composition
criteria.task: Implement a generation-tagged session event ledger with fd5/gen7 closed and fd5/gen8 created before a cached gen7 event dispatches. Prove the old event cannot touch the new session or freed storage. Add a 10-byte ET workload with a four-byte per-turn budget: retain software readiness across turns until EAGAIN; compare LT behavior.
criteria.purpose: A descriptor number permanently identifies the connection and every ET turn gets another edge.
